start.title: Start of Life
start.description: Your journey begins here, wallet light and the future wide open.

college-1.title: Move-In Day
college-1.description: You haul boxes into a tiny dorm room and call it home.

college-2.title: Tuition Bill
college-2.description: The registrar's office sends a bill that makes your eyes water.

college-3.title: Late-Night Study
college-3.description: Coffee, highlighters, and a textbook you swear you'll finish.

college-4.title: Campus Job
college-4.description: A work-study gig in the library covers just enough pizza money.

college-5.title: Group Project
college-5.description: Somehow you end up doing most of the slides. Again.

college-6.title: Scholarship Win
college-6.description: Your essay wins a surprise scholarship check.

college-7.title: Finals Week
college-7.description: Five exams in four days. You survive on instant noodles.

college-8.title: Cap and Gown
college-8.description: You slip into your cap and gown — officially a graduate.

grad-fair.title: Grad Job Fair
grad-fair.description: Recruiters line the quad, eager to hire fresh graduates like you.

work-1.title: First Paycheck
work-1.description: Your very first paycheck lands and it feels enormous.

work-2.title: Rent Due
work-2.description: The landlord's reminder text is impossible to ignore.

work-3.title: Overtime Shift
work-3.description: You pick up an extra shift and your feet regret it by nine.

work-4.title: New Skills
work-4.description: A weekend workshop teaches you a trick your boss loves.

work-5.title: Steady Hustle
work-5.description: Word gets around that you're reliable, and reliable pays off.

first-job-fair.title: First Job Fair
first-job-fair.description: Local employers set up booths, hunting for hungry new talent.

main-1.title: Apartment Hunt
main-1.description: You sign a lease on a place that's almost big enough.

main-2.title: Grocery Run
main-2.description: The cart somehow costs more than you planned. Again.

main-3.title: Gym Membership
main-3.description: You commit to getting fit. The treadmill remains skeptical.

main-4.title: Side Hustle
main-4.description: Selling handmade candles online brings in a nice little bonus.

main-5.title: Car Trouble
main-5.description: The check-engine light wins the staring contest.

main-6.title: Payday
main-6.description: Direct deposit hits — the best notification of the week.

main-7.title: Weekend Trip
main-7.description: A spontaneous road trip empties your wallet and fills your camera roll.

main-8.title: Good Review
main-8.description: Your manager praises your work in front of everyone.

main-9.title: Lucky Find
main-9.description: You stumble into a little story worth remembering.

main-10.title: Streaming Bill
main-10.description: Somehow you're subscribed to six different services.

main-11.title: Pay Raise Talk
main-11.description: You ask for a raise and, to your shock, actually get one.

main-12.title: Payday
main-12.description: The paycheck lands right on schedule, as always.

main-13.title: Neighborhood BBQ
main-13.description: The whole block shows up and someone brings way too much potato salad.

main-14.title: Ring Shopping
main-14.description: You linger a little too long at the jewelry counter window.

marriage.title: Wedding Day
marriage.description: Vows are exchanged, tears are shed, and it's official — you're married!

family-1.title: Nursery Setup
family-1.description: You paint the nursery a cheerful yellow and assemble a crib at midnight.

family-2.title: New Baby
family-2.description: A tiny new roommate arrives, and nothing is ever quiet again.

family-3.title: Family Vacation
family-3.description: Sandy shoes and sunburns — everyone agrees it was worth it.

family-4.title: School Play
family-4.description: Your kid nails the lead role and you tear up in the third row.

family-5.title: Piano Lessons
family-5.description: The scales are rough, but there's real promise in there somewhere.

family-6.title: Second Baby
family-6.description: The house gets a little louder and a lot more full of love.

family-7.title: Soccer Season
family-7.description: Weekend mornings become sideline cheering and orange slices.

family-8.title: Family Portrait
family-8.description: Everyone actually smiles at the same time — frame it immediately.

fast-1.title: Big Promotion
fast-1.description: Your boss hands you a new title and a real raise to match.

fast-2.title: Networking Night
fast-2.description: A chance conversation turns into a lucrative referral bonus.

fast-3.title: Payday
fast-3.description: Overtime finally shows up on the pay stub.

fast-4.title: Client Win
fast-4.description: You land the account everyone said was impossible.

fast-5.title: Conference Talk
fast-5.description: Your talk goes viral in the industry and leadership takes notice.

fast-6.title: Payday
fast-6.description: Another two weeks down, another deposit in.

fast-7.title: Bonus Season
fast-7.description: The year-end bonus is bigger than expected. Cue happy dance.

fast-8.title: Corner Office
fast-8.description: You finally get a door that closes and a window that opens.

home-buying.title: House Hunting
home-buying.description: You tour open houses all weekend, mentally moving in furniture.

risky-1.title: Startup Bet
risky-1.description: You pour savings into a friend's startup and spin to see what comes back.

risky-2.title: Stock Tip
risky-2.description: Your 'sure thing' stock tip tanks and you cover the group's laughs with drinks.

risky-3.title: Poker Night
risky-3.description: Lady luck sits at your table all night long.

risky-4.title: Garage Sale
risky-4.description: Strangers pay real money for your old junk — spin to see the haul.

risky-5.title: Market Crash
risky-5.description: The market dips hard and your portfolio winces.

risky-6.title: Lottery Ticket
risky-6.description: A dollar ticket, a lucky scratch, and a spin for the payout.

risky-7.title: Surprise Bonus
risky-7.description: An old investment finally pays off, and everyone chips in envy.

risky-8.title: Bidding War
risky-8.description: An auction gets competitive and your paddle goes up one too many times.

safe-1.title: Coupon Clipping
safe-1.description: Your stack of coupons actually pays off at checkout.

safe-2.title: Garden Harvest
safe-2.description: The backyard tomatoes finally ripen, saving a grocery trip.

safe-3.title: Budget Win
safe-3.description: You stick to the budget for once and it actually feels great.

safe-4.title: Interest Payout
safe-4.description: The savings account quietly earns its keep.

safe-5.title: Yard Sale
safe-5.description: Old clothes and books turn into a tidy stack of cash.

safe-6.title: Cashback Bonus
safe-6.description: The credit card's cashback finally adds up to something real.

safe-7.title: Refund Check
safe-7.description: A tax refund shows up right when you'd forgotten to expect it.

safe-8.title: Quiet Savings
safe-8.description: Nothing dramatic happens — your piggy bank just quietly grows.

sunset-1.title: Retirement Fund
sunset-1.description: You check your retirement account and smile at the balance.

sunset-2.title: Payday
sunset-2.description: One of your very last paychecks lands.

sunset-3.title: Sunset Ahead
sunset-3.description: The finish line is close enough to see the glow.

retirement.title: Retirement
retirement.description: You close the office door for the last time and step into retirement.

log.message: Welcome to LIFE JOURNEY! Players: Ana, Ben, Cleo, Dee.
